execution: live site through existing signed-in Chrome controls; original-message exports graded locally
notes: Single-trial smoke rerun on the deployed fixes; no statistical reliability claim. All 18 ordinary user prompts are unchanged from the earlier baseline. This run used normal Chrome controls, not the separate Playwright CLI runner.

The earlier baseline is preserved. Grading changed: composed calculations now require a server computation marker and independently recomputed result instead of a redundant standalone calculate call; shopping now requires a Products card with at least two priced EUR offers and battery evidence from successful prior observations of their exact product pages. Counts across grader revisions are not directly interchangeable.
All three calculation cases passed, including the composed EUR 40 / 4 brief, the discounted bill and Fahrenheit conversion. Production presentation tools recomputed embedded expressions.

Routing succeeded from the live Worker with the supplied public coordinates: 2218.6 metres and 319.2 seconds from the documented OSRM car service. The card labels its estimate as having no live traffic.

Shopping encountered a Google verification page and used ordinary retailer pages without bypassing that challenge. Five public retailer open/read requests received individual Allow once approvals; no persistent permissions changed. The result used Currys Ireland product pages: Sony ULT Wear EUR 129 with up to 30 hours ANC on / 50 hours off, and Bose QuietComfort EUR 239 with up to 24 hours as listed by the retailer. Product identity, ANC context, price and battery text were manually inspected in the saved observations. No purchase or basket change occurred.

The shopping trace completed with no failed tools or unconfirmed receipt, using observed product links and page reads. It did not require native input; deterministic browser regressions separately cover viewport restoration, a delivered click followed by capture failure, and truly uncertain input.
All four weather cases passed, with exact local dates, 1/2/7-day layouts, correct current-observation scope and no duplicate Markdown table.

Manual UI checks confirmed two-product shortlisting and the comparison view. The live expense table filtered to the two Food rows and sorted amounts descending (12.50, 7.50) and ascending (7.50, 12.50). These are operator checks, not additional automated model eval cases.

Operator effects: a session-check rate limit paused setup between trials and cleared after waiting/reloading; several browser-control timeouts occurred around new-agent submission. Drafts and saved history were inspected before continuing. Every exported trial contains its exact request once; no prompt was resubmitted. No failed model turn or renderer fallback was observed.

Shopping also repeated its card facts in a Markdown table. This suite currently scores table duplication for weather and composed briefs, not shopping; the pass is not a comprehensive prose or visual-quality score.

All 18 fresh eval agents were recoverably archived after export. Private original-message archives, UI evidence, screenshots and full grader outputs remain under ignored evals/rich-answers/results/fixed-2026-10-18.
